In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] between the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the Yuuzhan Vong '''conquered''' the [[Gravlex Med system/Legends|Gravlex Med system]], having recently [[Battle of Dantooine (Yuuzhan Vong War)|taken]] the nearby [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]].
